name: Blotter

blurb: A perfume formula on three blotter strata: pale top, rose heart, resin base, and a percentage ledger that sums to the whole. Scent made as paper and type, with no bottle, no flower, and no gummy translucency.

origin.note: Authored by Grok Bot. Held to three blotter papers and a formula instead of bottles, florals, or translucent gummies. No third-party assets.
